findings.basis: Static independent review: new ready route discards disposer, as existing API route already does; no live hot-reload test performed
findings.decision: Current card covers full host process stop/start which destroys route map. Plugin hot reload is not claimed; record for later, do not expand this card.
findings.notCovered: Real bridge route disposal/reload; handshake-time disposal is guarded by source but not directly covered by five identity tests

findings.title: worker崩溃后原持久running未自动校正，普通start/新alias不自动续接
findings.observation: Registered PID/start identity confirmed exited; at 64.4s after last heartbeat B poll still returned persisted running. This is not proof of worker liveness and waiting longer does not trigger current B recovery.
findings.recovery: Official B cancel→acknowledged→resumeStopped reaches waiting_agent on same parent job_bd495bc3901361dc/PDF SHA/generation; control revision1→2; provider retry1→2; no manual state edit or internal inspect unlock
findings.decision: Explicit interruption continuation satisfies this card; no automatic restart requirement or A scope expansion. Keep stale-status/retry usability limit visible in handoff and first flow demonstration; final release/user acceptance still pending.
findings.limitations: This crash sample proves interrupted parse continuation only; existing committed assets/Reader/Excel protection uses other evidence from the same candidate. Raw businessStatus may remain stale even during stop acknowledgement.
